text: Over the last 30 days, visitor reviews for the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library have highlighted issues related to food quality and wait times, with all three reviews mentioning these areas. Service was noted in two reviews, while atmosphere was mentioned once. There were no critical reviews, and the average rating remained at 5.0. Attention to food and wait time could improve the overall visitor experience.

windows.60: Over the past 60 days, several visitors have expressed dissatisfaction with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly noting limited menu options, poor food quality, and long wait times. Three critical reviews highlighted issues such as a lack of available menu items during operating hours, slow service due to kitchen delays, and disappointing meal preparation. While the overall rating remains above four, concerns about food quality and service speed were the most frequent negative points. Other comments touched on the menu range and value, suggesting these areas may need further attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days show consistent concerns about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service issues included long wait times and periods when orders could not be taken due to kitchen delays. While the library itself received positive remarks, the café’s offerings and operations need attention to improve visitor satisfaction.
